names: P24 -- waterfront lawn (Bayfront Park approach, south of 499 Illinois St)
summary: A triangular waterfront lawn with a curved path south of 499 Illinois Street, visually resembling Bayfront Park's own style and possibly a continuation of it; real landscaped open land per satellite imagery, delineated by this project's owner-directed real-gap-fragment method rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. OCII's own September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P24' among the parcels already managed by the Port of San Francisco (not among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), consistent with it being complete by that date. Name and specific operator not confirmed by any source found.

milestones.text: Reported as the nearly 2-acre 'Mariposa Bayfront Park (P23/P24)', under construction and expected to be completed by the end of 2019

Already part of the Port of San Francisco's managed open-space inventory (not listed among the still-pending 'when built' parcels), per OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation to the Mission Bay CAC -- an upper bound on when this lawn was built, not its actual construction date

sources.title: Mission Bay Parks Open Space (CAC Item 2, September 2023)
sources.publisher: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org)

sources.title: Mission Bay Is Nearly Built Out, Mission Rock in the Wings

open_questions: The April 2019 SocketSite article names the combined P23/P24 area 'Mariposa Bayfront Park' -- not to be confused with Mariposa Park, OCII's own official P26 per its current open-space page (a separate, larger playground park at Mariposa and Owens streets; see this repo's mission_bay_p26_interchange_wedge record's own open_questions for a related P26 label conflict). Not reconciled here, only noted so the two 'Mariposa'-named places aren't conflated.

No source names this specific lawn or gives its own construction date beyond the April 2019 under-construction report; the Sept 2023 OCII document only establishes it existed and was already Port-managed by that date, which is an upper bound, not a build date.

Not confirmed whether this lawn was built as part of Bayfront Park's own 2024 construction (which it visually resembles and adjoins) or earlier, as part of 409/499 Illinois Street's 2008 completion (whose developer's own project page describes 'nearly an acre of waterfront outdoor space' at that building, per src-sksre-409-499illinois) -- no source ties this specific parcel's completion to either project, so no more specific date is asserted.

Whether OCII's own current numbering scheme still uses 'P24' for exactly this footprint was not independently confirmed -- OCII's current public Mission Bay South open-space page (sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space) does not list a P24 at all among the parcels it names (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6, P26).
